description: Upload a custom font file (TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2) from a public URL to the connected Templated account under the given family name. Use this when a design needs a font that isn't a Google Font; templates then use it as font_family. Returns the font. API reference: https://templated.io/docs

url.description: URL of the font file (TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2)

name: upload_font
